notes.title: The PRESETS bank of the
notes.text: The PRESETS bank of the TRX and EFM voices is named MD. ABOUT's credits are shorter.

notes.title: Web simulator
notes.text: Web simulator: the firmware compiled to WebAssembly, on the project's page, with MNM-1 demos (four projects built on the power-on kit: SID lead, DPRO pad, VO-6 voice, FM+ bass) and a reel of the 8-knob pages.
